name: Aelsia Story
summary: Aelsia Story is a 2.5D pixel-art fantasy MMORPG played in a web browser on PC and mobile, without downloading a client. Players choose from five first classes that branch into ten second classes, and can be reborn to continue up to level 120. The game features party dungeons built around tank, healer and damage roles with mechanics such as shared damage and spread markers, world bosses that appear for the whole server, and stronger mutated bosses at night. Most of its 100 mounts are tamed from wild monsters, and more than 140 pets can be collected. Other activities include crafting, cooking, gathering, fishing, player stalls and an auction market, personal houses, farming, guild territories and marriage.
